rationale: The Latin anchor *odor* (and *odoramen*) denotes the property or quality of a smell — a characteristic emanating from an object — rather than the subjective sensation experienced by a perceiver. The biblical quotation "odoratus est Dominus odorem suavitatis" ("the Lord smelled a sweet savour") likewise treats the odour as an objective property of the burnt offering, pointing to `olfactory_property.n.01` (a detectable chemical property) over `smell.n.01` (the internal sensory experience).
